about.heading: About
about.studyOnly: OpenRange is a study tool. It does not read your screen, show overlays or HUDs, or connect to any poker site. Hand-history import is for reviewing sessions after you play.
about.offline: Everything runs on this device. There are no accounts, no telemetry, and no network requests after the app has loaded.
about.milestone: This is an early build: the equity calculator works; drills, charts and lessons arrive in later milestones.
equity.heading: Equity calculator
equity.intro: Equity is your share of the pot if all the cards are dealt out with no more betting, counting a split pot as half. Enter a hand (AhKh) or a range (QQ+, AKs, T9s-54s) for each player.
equity.exactNote: Exact: all {runouts} ways to complete the board were checked for every possible matchup (no sampling error).
equity.mcNote: Estimate from {samples} random deals (seed {seed}). The ± value is one standard error: the true equity is within about two of them 95% of the time.
solver.heading: Postflop solver
solver.intro: Solve a heads-up flop, turn or river spot on this device. OOP (out of position) acts first. Bet sizes are percentages of the pot; raise sizes are percentages of the pot after calling; 'a' means all-in. River spots solve in seconds; turn spots in seconds to a minute; flop spots can take many minutes in the browser, so start with small trees.
solver.allIn: All-in if a bet uses ≥ this % of stack
solver.cancelled: Cancelled. The solver's memory was freed.

solver.evNote: EV is in big blinds, measured from the start of this spot (pot winnings minus chips put in on this street). Compare actions within a row; actions a solver mixes between have almost equal EV.

charts.heading: Preflop charts
charts.intro: Each chart shows, for one decision, how often each starting hand takes each action. Split cells are mixed strategies: both actions have (almost) the same EV, so either is fine. Pick a hand to see the EV of each action. Every chart says where its numbers come from.
charts.none: No charts have been generated yet (run solver-cli gen-charts).
charts.legend: Actions and how often they are taken
charts.exactNote: Solved to an exploitability of {ex} bb per hand.
charts.approxWarning: These charts come from an approximate model. Push/fold charts for 3+ players are solved by sampling, and CFR with several players isn't guaranteed to find an equilibrium; cash-game charts also replace postflop play with an equity-realization model. Use them as a guide, not as exact answers.
charts.bandHeading: Outside the sanity checks: don't study these as reference yet.
charts.bandNote: Known cause: the equity-realization model (v1) gives weak hands the same realization as strong ones, so the blinds defend too wide and late positions open too tight. A model calibrated from OpenRange's own postflop solves is planned.
charts.notReached: {hand} never gets to this decision with this strategy, so there is nothing to show.
charts.reach: This hand reaches this decision {pct} of the time when dealt (because of your own earlier choices).
charts.pickCell: Pick a hand in the grid to see its frequencies and the EV of each action.
charts.evNote: EV in {unit}. Within one hand, compare actions: the difference is how much a choice costs.
pushfold.heading: Push/fold calculator (heads-up decision, chip EV or ICM)
pushfold.intro: Everyone else has folded. One player moves all-in or folds; the other calls or folds. The solver finds the exact equilibrium for these two decisions over all 1326 starting hands, with exact card removal. With payouts it uses ICM (Malmuth–Harville) on the whole table, so the other players' stacks matter too.
pushfold.stacksHint: Every player still in the tournament, e.g. 12, 20, 8.
pushfold.pusher: Seat that shoves (usually the small blind)
pushfold.caller: Seat that calls (usually the big blind)
pushfold.badge: Exact for this model · computed on this device · {iterations} iterations
pushfold.note: Model: blinds 0.5/1; only these two players' decisions are solved (everyone else folds); a player who busts takes the lowest remaining prize, shared equally if two bust at once. EVs are in bb (chip EV) or in prize units (ICM) and include what each player already posted.
